name: silvershop/product-feed
description: Channel-agnostic product-feed core for SilverShop (CMS 6): selects feed-eligible catalogue products, normalises each through silvershop/catalog-data, hands them to a pluggable channel serializer (the FeedFormat / ChannelFeed registry seam), writes a static feed file atomically and regenerates it on a schedule. A channel connector (e.g. silvershop/product-feed-google) plugs in without the core knowing any channel specifics.

suggest.silvershop/product-feed-google: The Google Merchant channel connector (RSS 2.0 + g: namespace).
suggest.silvershop/brands: Enables include/exclude feed selection by Brand.
suggest.silvershop/product-identity: Adds GTIN/MPN, surfaced through catalog-data into the feed.
